description: Changes rooms and multiplayer: rooms policy, where server/*.js runs, Fog, P2P, connections, no-code matchmaking. A rooms change that discards saved room data fails (rooms_data_loss) unless confirmRoomsChange is true. Waits in the draft until neblla_promote "save" (env "pro" for the users). More: neblla_get_llms tools/update_app_rooms

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

confirmRoomsChange.description: true applies a rooms change that discards saved room data (only after the developer agreed).

connection.description: How often devices keep in touch with Neblla; null goes back to the defaults.

connections.description: How devices talk: all, p2p, server or none.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

fog.description: Fog settings { window, latencyWatch, stepTimeout, direct }; merged, null resets them.

matchmaking.description: No-code matchmaking { mode, rule: count | timer | count_then_timer | button, minPlayers, … }, merged; mode "nocode" rewrites server/gathering.js.

p2p.description: { allow, turn }: allow false turns WebRTC off; turn true offers Neblla's relay, which spends quota.

rooms.description: The whole rooms policy (replaces it), shaped as neblla_get_app `rooms`: policy, allowedTypes, requireLogin, anticheat, keepAwake…

server.description: For "own" and "cloud": the server's settings (see the guide section).

serverMode.description: Where server/*.js runs: "js" (Fog, a user's device), "own" (your server) or "cloud" (Neblla's).

name: neblla_update_app_rooms
title: Change rooms and multiplayer settings
